references.excerpt: Any Calendar Month Within The 10-Year Period Preceding His Normal Retirement Date.

references.excerpt: Employment Is Terminated By Reason Of Disability After He Has Completed 10 Or More Years Of Service And... Entitled To Receive A Social Security Disability Benefit.
